selection_reasoning: The 'find lever' task is a straightforward observation/navigation task that requires the agent to locate a lever placed in the Minecraft scene. It is easily verifiable (the agent must look at or approach the lever), doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, and can be set up in an interesting scene that requires some exploration. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the lever and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. The lever is at spawn-relative (3, 2, -4) on the north wall. max_distance=5 ensures the player moves from spawn (which is ~5.4 blocks away) toward the lever, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than just passing nearby.

scene_description: A compact enclosed stone brick room (10x10 blocks) with a lever mounted on the north wall at eye level. The room contains several landmarks (crafting table, furnace, bookshelves) to make exploration interesting, and glowstone ceiling lights ensure visibility. The lever is placed at position ~3 ~2 ~-4 on the north wall facing south, next to a redstone lamp.
task_text: Find the lever in this stone brick room. Look around the walls to locate it.
design_notes: The lever is at spawn-relative (3, 2, -4) on the north wall at eye level. The room is 10x10 with walls from -5 to +5 on X and Z axes. Ceiling is at y+3 with glowstone for lighting. Player spawns at center (0,0,0 relative). The lever is about 5.4 blocks from spawn, requiring the player to walk toward the north wall and look at it. Multiple landmarks (crafting table at (-2,1,2), furnace at (3,1,2), bookshelves at (-4,-3 corner)) provide visual interest.
